cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI -5.18% · Brent -0.26% · NatGas -1.50%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Power & IPPs is doing the heavy lifting at +1.11%.

cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Power & IPPs at +1.11%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -1.98%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: RUN is the standout at +9.94%
cards.body: Leaders: RUN +9.94%, ENPH +5.11%, SEDG +4.54%, WFRD +2.85%, HAL +2.00%. Laggards: EOSE -6.91%, PWR -3.24%, ETN -2.18%, GEV -2.05%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
